title: Case 038: Failed delivery has returned to sender and the customer still wants the order

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The failed original delivery is physically back at the merchant. The recipient still wants the item and has confirmed the existing delivery details.
initial_request: I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details.

outcome: The merchant confirms a new shipment reference; receipt remains pending.
boundaries: New shipment reference does not prove dispatch or receipt; do not reuse the old delivered status.

events.body: DL-038 for TG-038 is physically back in our stock after failed delivery and return-to-sender. Item accepted as reshippable. Our account team has authenticated Sella’s order-portal session; stored destination is Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay. A new dispatch requires merchant approval.
I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.
Please approve reshipment of TG-038 to Sella’s unchanged verified order destination, Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk. Warehouse confirms the original item is back and reshippable.
Reshipment approved at no additional charge. New shipment DL-038-R is created for TG-038 with the confirmed destination. The new parcel has not been handed to the carrier yet.
